name: PS4: Load GoldHEN (wake → wait → send goldhen.bin)
description: Wake the PS4, wait 8 seconds for a manually enabled BIN loader, send goldhen.bin to TCP 9020, then verify the payload-sender port stayed open.
notes: PS4 takes longer than PS5 to open the GoldHEN exploit listener, so the port check retries the wake + wait pair. Requires your own compatible goldhen.bin (and ftp_server.bin for the FTP template). These templates cannot bootstrap a jailbreak from a closed BIN-loader port.

steps.name: Check GoldHEN port 9020 (retry wake on fail)

author: P5 Manager
